import pathlib,sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'tools'))
from lsp_client import Client
entry=(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'examples/runtime_errors/main.void').resolve();uri=entry.as_uri();original=entry.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
for build in ['debug','ci-release']:
 with Client(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'build'/build/'voidls',entry) as c:
  c.initialize();pid=c.process.pid
  c.notify('textDocument/didOpen',{'textDocument':{'uri':uri,'languageId':'void','version':1,'text':'u\n'+original}});c.sync()
  response=c.request('textDocument/completion',{'textDocument':{'uri':uri},'position':{'line':0,'character':1}})[0]
  assert 'error' not in response,response
  c.notify('textDocument/didChange',{'textDocument':{'uri':uri,'version':2},'contentChanges':[{'text':original}]})
  assert not [d for n in c.sync() for d in n['diagnostics']],build
  line=next(i for i,s in enumerate(original.splitlines()) if 'arithmetic.calculate' in s);col=original.splitlines()[line].index('calculate')+1
  definition=c.request('textDocument/definition',{'textDocument':{'uri':uri},'position':{'line':line,'character':col}})[0]
  assert definition['result']['uri']==(entry.parent/'arithmetic.void').as_uri(),definition
  assert c.process.pid==pid and c.process.poll() is None
  c.shutdown();assert c.process.returncode==0
  assert not any(x in bytes(c.logs).decode('utf-8') for x in ['map::at','Internal language server failure'])
  print(build,'exact runtime_errors u overlay -> safe completion -> original imported definition, same process, clean exit 0')
assert entry.read_text(encoding='utf-8')==original
